title: H2S gas detector alarm silenced without donning SCBA apparatus
description: Control room alarm sounded for 12 ppm H2S at compressor packing gland; field operator acknowledged horn without donning escape pack.
breachedSafetyControls: Mandatory 30-minute SCBA donning violation
Failure to evacuate downwind personnel to muster point
Unverified manual override of siren warning
rootCause: False alarm complacency due to frequent intermittent sensor drift; lack of routine live muster drills.
recommendedAction: Recalibrate all toxic gas optical sensors; conduct unannounced toxic gas leak emergency drill across all shifts.
assignedInvestigator: Dr. P. K. Saikia (Lead Process Safety Specialist)

title: Unrestrained high-pressure flexible hose whip during hydrostatic test
description: During 3000 PSI pressure test of choke manifold, high-pressure test hose whip-check safety cable was found unfastened at rig cellar.
breachedSafetyControls: Missing whip-check cable on pressurized connection
Personnel inside barricaded hydrostatic exclusion zone
Absence of certified high-pressure hobble clamps
rootCause: Third-party contractor overlooked securing safety stockings during rapid pressure rig-up.
recommendedAction: Install engineered whip-arrestor socks on all hoses >= 1000 PSI; verify exclusion zone integrity before pressure build-up.
assignedInvestigator: Nilotpal Bora (Head of Drilling Operations & Safety)

title: Improper chemical drum stacking in hazardous store warehouse
description: Barrels of corrosion inhibitor and demulsifier stacked three tiers high without interlocking pallet dividers on uneven concrete surface.
breachedSafetyControls: Exceeded maximum safe two-tier drum stacking limit
Absence of spill containment bund integrity
Incompatible chemicals stored adjacent without barrier
rootCause: Warehouse space constraint caused by delayed chemical requisition dispatch.
recommendedAction: Re-palletize into two-tier racking systems; inspect epoxy coating of spill containment sump.
assignedInvestigator: Nilotpal Bora (Head of Drilling Operations & Safety)

title: Bypassing high-pressure safety interlock on separator bypass valve
description: Operator observed placing a mechanical bypass wedge on the high-pressure relief valve pilot line during line cleaning to avoid automated trip.
breachedSafetyControls: SIS Override without approved MoC
Absence of designated Area Safety Permit
Lack of independent risk assessment
rootCause: Pressure to meet daily production targets; lack of supervisory physical verification during night shift.
recommendedAction: Immediate stop-work order; re-validate instrument bypass logs and retrain operators on OISD-STD-152.
assignedInvestigator: Kabir Dutta (Principal Pipeline Safety Auditor)

title: Corroded firewater monitor valve handle difficult to operate
description: Fire monitor #6 at tank farm perimeter required pipe wrench to rotate due to salt crust and lack of lubrication on swivel joint.
breachedSafetyControls: Weekly fire protection equipment operational test neglected
Swivel joint greasing nipples clogged
Delayed maintenance work order
rootCause: Monsoon weathering and inadequate preventative lubrication PM scheduling.
recommendedAction: Service and grease all monitor swivel joints; conduct full flow throw test during Sunday fire drill.

title: Maintenance commenced on crude transfer line without positive mechanical blinding
description: Fitter unbolted flange bolts on 8-inch pressurized crude header relying solely on a leaking butterfly valve without slip blind or LOTO lock.
breachedSafetyControls: Absence of physical blind / spectacle flange
Single valve isolation on hydrocarbon line
Lockout-Tagout (LOTO) missing
rootCause: Inadequate PTW cross-check by isolation authority; failure to perform zero-energy atmospheric pressure bleed.
recommendedAction: Suspend maintenance permit; enforce mandatory double block and bleed (DBB) protocol for all live hydrocarbon circuits.
assignedInvestigator: Dr. P. K. Saikia (Lead Process Safety Specialist)

title: Confined space entry into slug catcher without multi-gas test
description: Two vessel cleaners stepped inside horizontal slug catcher manway before gas testing for H2S, LEL, and Oxygen deficiency was completed.
breachedSafetyControls: Failure to conduct 4-point atmospheric gas test
No continuous forced air ventilation fan running
Attendant absent from vessel manway
rootCause: Entry permit was pre-signed by supervisor offsite without verifying continuous gas monitoring instrument.
recommendedAction: Revoke entry authorization; implement calibrated personal 4-gas detectors for all entrants and install automated entry turnstile.
assignedInvestigator: Nilotpal Bora (Head of Drilling Operations & Safety)

title: Winch wire rope frayed during 15-ton tubular lifting operation
description: Secondary hoisting wire rope showed broken strands and crushing damage near sheave drum while lifting casing pipe bundle over wellhead.
breachedSafetyControls: Pre-lift visual rigging inspection not logged
Lifting path traversed directly over active Christmas tree
Exceeded permissible wire rope fatigue criteria
rootCause: Preventative maintenance interval overdue by 45 operating days; rigging supervisor failed to inspect spool drum.
recommendedAction: Immediate de-reeving and replacement of wire rope; enforce third-party NDT certification for all rig winches.
assignedInvestigator: Arunav Phukan (Deputy General Manager - HSE)

title: Scaffolding dismantled without harness tether at 18m height
description: Contractor technician spotted working on rig derrick beam at 18 meters with full body harness unclipped from the retractable lifeline.
breachedSafetyControls: 100% Tie-Off Policy violation
Missing derrick monkey-board safety latch
Defective lanyard carabiner clip
rootCause: Shortage of dual-lanyard shock absorbers; complacency regarding short-duration tasks at elevation.
recommendedAction: Confiscate single-lanyards across the rig; mandate daily pre-climb harness inspection sign-off.
assignedInvestigator: Dr. P. K. Saikia (Lead Process Safety Specialist)

title: Excavation near 16-inch high-pressure trunk pipeline without hand digging
description: JCB backhoe bucket was operated within 0.8m of underground live hydrocarbon line without exploratory trial pit or pipe locator scan.
breachedSafetyControls: Failure to conduct ultrasonic pipe locator sweep
Mechanical excavation within 1.5m safe buffer zone
Pipeline right-of-way permit not endorsed by pipeline manager
rootCause: Contractor urgency to finish drainage ditch before heavy monsoon rains; lack of pipeline patrol escort.
recommendedAction: Mandate hand digging within 2 meters of marked ROW; conduct mandatory pipeline integrity verification.
assignedInvestigator: Arunav Phukan (Deputy General Manager - HSE)

rootCause: Inadequate PTW cross-check by isolation authority; failure to perform zero-energy atmospheric pressure bleed.

title: Overdue hydro-test date on breathing air cascade cylinders
description: Cascade cylinder bank supplying breathing air to mask manifold had expired 5-year hydraulic pressure stamp by 3 months.
breachedSafetyControls: Use of out-of-certification pressurized vessel
Breathing air quality test certificate not displayed
Inventory management tracking oversight
rootCause: Discrepancy in supplier calibration register; logistics delay in cylinder rotation.
recommendedAction: Tag out expired cascade bank immediately; mobilize certified mobile hydrostatic testing unit to base.
assignedInvestigator: Arunav Phukan (Deputy General Manager - HSE)

title: Defective earth continuity bond on fuel dispensing nozzle
description: Static grounding wire on diesel transfer nozzle found snapped at terminal lug during tanker refuelling operation.
breachedSafetyControls: Failure of bonding continuity test (< 10 ohms)
Refueling continued without verified static earthing
Daily tanker grounding checklist not verified
rootCause: Mechanical fatigue of grounding clamp cable caused by vehicle roll-over; poor daily inspection routine.
recommendedAction: Replace all static grounding clamps with retractable spring-loaded reels with integrated continuity indicator LEDs.
assignedInvestigator: Dr. P. K. Saikia (Lead Process Safety Specialist)

rootCause: Stagnant potable water dead-leg line; lack of custodial maintenance check.

description: JCB backhoe bucket was operated within 0.8m of underground live hydrocarbon line without exploratory trial pit or pipe locator scan.
breachedSafetyControls: Failure to conduct ultrasonic pipe locator sweep
Mechanical excavation within 1.5m safe buffer zone
Pipeline right-of-way permit not endorsed by pipeline manager
rootCause: Contractor urgency to finish drainage ditch before heavy monsoon rains; lack of pipeline patrol escort.
recommendedAction: Mandate hand digging within 2 meters of marked ROW; conduct mandatory pipeline integrity verification.
assignedInvestigator: Arunav Phukan (Deputy General Manager - HSE)

title: Hot grinding work conducted within 3 meters of crude oil sampling point
description: Fabrication crew using angle grinder near open bleed valve with spark shower drifting towards active crude oil sampling bottle rack.
breachedSafetyControls: No flame-retardant spark containment blanket deployed
Continuous explosive gas detector (LEL) was switched off
Hot work permit lacked hydrocarbon isolation validation
rootCause: Underestimation of flammability radius during minor pipe-support structural touch-up.
recommendedAction: Immediate cessation of hot work; deploy portable pressurized welding habitat for any future hot work in Zone 1 / Zone 2.
assignedInvestigator: Nilotpal Bora (Head of Drilling Operations & Safety)

rootCause: Stagnant potable water dead-leg line; lack of custodial maintenance check.

title: Improper chemical drum stacking in hazardous store warehouse
description: Barrels of corrosion inhibitor and demulsifier stacked three tiers high without interlocking pallet dividers on uneven concrete surface.
breachedSafetyControls: Exceeded maximum safe two-tier drum stacking limit
Absence of spill containment bund integrity
Incompatible chemicals stored adjacent without barrier
rootCause: Warehouse space constraint caused by delayed chemical requisition dispatch.
recommendedAction: Re-palletize into two-tier racking systems; inspect epoxy coating of spill containment sump.
assignedInvestigator: Nilotpal Bora (Head of Drilling Operations & Safety)

title: Unauthorized personnel inside crane tail-swing radius during skid offloading
description: Two rig helpers walked directly behind 50-ton mobile crane counterweight while slewing heavy generator package onto concrete plinth.
breachedSafetyControls: Absence of barricade tape around crane slewing perimeter
Banksman diverted attention to phone call
Failure to maintain eye contact with crane operator
rootCause: Inadequate barricading materials deployed at temporary offloading site; helper inattention.
recommendedAction: Deploy magnetic barrier posts around all active slewing cranes; retrain banksmen on non-distraction protocol.
assignedInvestigator: Dr. P. K. Saikia (Lead Process Safety Specialist)

title: Corroded firewater monitor valve handle difficult to operate
description: Fire monitor #6 at tank farm perimeter required pipe wrench to rotate due to salt crust and lack of lubrication on swivel joint.
breachedSafetyControls: Weekly fire protection equipment operational test neglected
Swivel joint greasing nipples clogged
Delayed maintenance work order
rootCause: Monsoon weathering and inadequate preventative lubrication PM scheduling.
recommendedAction: Service and grease all monitor swivel joints; conduct full flow throw test during Sunday fire drill.

title: Overdue hydro-test date on breathing air cascade cylinders

Inventory management tracking oversight
rootCause: Discrepancy in supplier calibration register; logistics delay in cylinder rotation.
recommendedAction: Tag out expired cascade bank immediately; mobilize certified mobile hydrostatic testing unit to base.
